out_r) noexcept {\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        // std::clamp(v, lo, hi): (v 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]) : nullptr;\n    const float* wet_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n\n    auto soft = [](float x) {\n        if (x > 3.0f) return 1.0f;\n        if (x < -3.0f) return -1.0f;\n        float x2 = x * x;\n        return x * (27.0f + x2) / (27.0f + 9.0f * x2);\n    };\n\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n    if    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// DISTORT_FOLD: Wavefolder with ADAA (Antiderivative Antialiasing)\n// ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* symmetry = (inst.inputs[2] != float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_buf, i, dry_const);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_buf, i, wet_const);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? reduce aliasing.\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_distort_tube(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* bias = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* dry_level = (inst.inputs[3] != 0xFFFF) ? ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]) : nullptr;\n ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* drive = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* warmth = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfQacZtT8vCrCKaQt2WqY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I replaced the tanh approximation in `op_distort_tanh` with a cheaper one, and it now runs about 11–15% faster. `op_distort_soft` is unchanged. The change is only to `cedar/include/cedar/opcodes/distortion.hpp` and is left uncommitted.\n\n**Results (2 of 10 check runs used):**\n- The check passed the file allowlist, the build and the equality test on the fixed stimuli.\n- The tanh approximation's error measured -112.8 dBFS, below the -100 dBFS limit.\n- `op_distort_tanh`: 54.5–54.8 → 47.7–49.0 ns/block.\n- `op_distort_soft`: 43.0 → 43.0–43.4 ns/block, within noise.\n- The hidden stimuli, unit test suites and full benchmark only run at the final verification, so they haven't been checked yet.\n\n**What changed:** the old kernel was limited by instruction count (about 23 vector ops plus a divide per 8 samples). `tanh_approx_avx2` now computes tanh(y) = 1 − 2/(1 + e^(2y)), with y clamped to ±9, in about 19 ops:\n- **Splitting e^(2y):** a magic-number add (1.5·2²³ + 127) rounds 2y·log₂e to an integer n. Shifting that sum left by 23 bits builds 2ⁿ directly, so no separate rounding instruction is needed.\n- **The fractional part:** 2^f, for |f| ≤ 0.5, comes from a degree-5 Taylor series reduced to degree 4 (Chebyshev economisation). Its relative error is under 8e-6, which bounds the tanh error at under 4e-6 absolute.\n- **No special cases:** the formula works for both signs and for small y, so the sign fix-up and small-input branch from attempt 1 aren't needed. The `// simd: approx tanh` marker is kept.\n\nNear zero the error is absolute, not relative. For tiny or denormal inputs the output can differ from tanh(y) by up to about 1e-6 rather than staying proportional to y. That meets the rule as written (\"about 1e-5 absolute\"), but it would fail if the hidden-stimuli check measures error relative to signal level.\n\nI left `op_distort_soft` alone because its speed is set by its two exact divisions per vector, and bit-identity rules out removing either one.\n\nIDEA: tanh approx throughput-bound on ~23 vector ops (13/6 rational + div) -> replaced with 1-2/(1+e^(2y)) using magic-add 2^n exponent build and economised degree-4 2^f poly (~19 ops, no sign/small-y fixups) (distort_tanh 1.11–1.15x, null test -112.8 dBFS, distort_soft unchanged)"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":491,"cache_read_input_tokens":27851,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":491},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"16f1b300-eaa5-4c06-b445-a156cdaa3c58","uuid":"16d2f879-a928-4f7f-a155-38ef0aa9c47a","timestamp":"2026-09-25T17:50:02.582Z","request_id":"req_011CfQacZRBRfbFjtirGMdYa"}
